result.brief: 提出统一图像基础模型 WeLM-Image，用 Mixture-of-Transformers 共享注意力并分离理解/生成参数，结合 MoE 稀疏容量、数据引擎与少步蒸馏，统一文生图、指令编辑与多参考合成。
result.reason: Unified image foundation model sharing attention across understanding and generation paths with MoT/MoE, plus distillation; concrete transfer to unified understanding-generation and generation efficiency.
